findings.title: Decoupling cap too far from U8
findings.description: Nearest decoupling cap to U8 (SP3019-04HTG) is 9.4mm away. Each mm of trace adds 0.3-0.8 nH of loop inductance, reducing decoupling effectiveness at high frequencies. Shared net: USB3_TX_CONN_P.
findings.recommendation: Move decoupling cap within 2-3mm of U8 power pins.
findings.summary: Decoupling cap too far from U8

findings.summary: Decoupling cap too far from U9

findings.recommendation: Place a via directly adjacent to C10 pads. Use fat, short traces from cap pads to via.

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J2
findings.description: Connector J2 (LPJG16402AQNL) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add common-mode choke on TX/RX pairs near J2. Ethernet magnetics (if not integrated) provide galvanic isolation and CM rejection.
findings.summary: No EMC filtering near J2

findings.title: Insufficient ground pins on J2
findings.description: J2 (LPJG16402AQNL) has 0 ground pin(s) for 16 signal pins. Recommended: at least 4 ground pins for adequate return current path and cable shielding.
findings.recommendation: Ensure J2 has sufficient ground pins. For high-speed interfaces, ground pins should be distributed among signal pins, not grouped at one end.
findings.summary: Insufficient ground pins on J2

findings.title: Insufficient ground pins on U9
findings.description: U9 (USBLC6-2SC6) has 1 ground pin(s) for 4 signal pins. Recommended: at least 2 ground pins for adequate return current path and cable shielding.
findings.recommendation: Ensure U9 has sufficient ground pins. For high-speed interfaces, ground pins should be distributed among signal pins, not grouped at one end.
findings.summary: Insufficient ground pins on U9

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (58×36mm, εr=4.4) cavity resonances: (1,0) at 1232 MHz; (0,1) at 1985 MHz; (1,1) at 2336 MHz; (2,0) at 2464 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.
findings.summary: Board cavity resonance frequencies

findings.title: No ground via near ESD device U9
findings.description: U9 (esd_ic) has no ground stitching via within 3mm. The TVS ground pad inductance is the most critical parasitic in ESD protection — each nH adds ~37.5V overshoot during an 8kV strike.
findings.recommendation: Add multiple ground vias directly adjacent to U9 ground pad. Use fat, short traces to ground plane.
findings.summary: No ground via near ESD device U9

findings.title: U6 harmonics in 30-88 MHz band
findings.description: U6 (SY8089AAAC) switching at 0.5 MHz has 117 harmonics in the 30-88 MHz band (harmonics 60-176). Envelope rolloff at 32 MHz (-40 dB/decade above).
findings.recommendation: Minimize switching loop area for U6. Place input cap as close as possible. Consider spread-spectrum modulation if available.
findings.summary: U6 harmonics in 30-88 MHz band

findings.title: U6 harmonics in 88-216 MHz band
findings.description: U6 (SY8089AAAC) switching at 0.5 MHz has 257 harmonics in the 88-216 MHz band (harmonics 176-432). Envelope rolloff at 32 MHz (-40 dB/decade above).
findings.recommendation: Minimize switching loop area for U6. Place input cap as close as possible. Consider spread-spectrum modulation if available.
findings.summary: U6 harmonics in 88-216 MHz band

findings.title: U6 harmonics in 216-960 MHz band
findings.description: U6 (SY8089AAAC) switching at 0.5 MHz has 1489 harmonics in the 216-960 MHz band (harmonics 432-1920). Envelope rolloff at 32 MHz (-40 dB/decade above).
findings.recommendation: Minimize switching loop area for U6. Place input cap as close as possible. Consider spread-spectrum modulation if available.
findings.summary: U6 harmonics in 216-960 MHz band

findings.title: U6 harmonic envelope
findings.description: U6 (SY8089AAAC) switching at 0.50 MHz, duty ≈50%. Harmonic envelope: flat to 0.3 MHz, -20 dB/dec to 32 MHz, -40 dB/dec above. Harmonics extend into FCC test range starting at 60th harmonic.
findings.recommendation: Minimize the hot loop area (input cap → high-side switch → inductor → low-side switch → input cap). Every halving of loop area reduces emissions by 6 dB.
findings.summary: U6 harmonic envelope
